item.title: Bigg Boss 20: Salman Khan Slams Yung DSA, Scout OP For 'Bullying' Qazi Touqeer Over Spitting Row
item.description: Salman Khan called out housemates Yung DSA and Scout OP for ganging up on Qazi Touqeer after a week of clashes, even as Gauahar Khan later criticised Touqeer's own conduct in the dispute.

item.title: Bigg Boss 20: Arishfa Khan Breaks Down, Trashes Room After Losing Lifeline In Ration Task
item.description: Housemates voted to strip Arishfa Khan of a lifeline to save the house's ration, and her angry, pillow-throwing reaction split the group.

item.title: Roadies Rebirth: Karishma Talwar's Splitsvilla Reunion With Prince Narula Sparks Fan Edits
item.description: A viral Roadies Rebirth promo reunited former Splitsvilla 8 contestants Karishma Talwar and Prince Narula, prompting him to publicly clarify she was never his ex and ask fans to stop pairing them in edits.

item.title: Rio Ferdinand Branded A 'Disgrace' After Body-Shaming Reply To Creator Saeed TV
item.description: The former Manchester United defender faced online backlash after mocking content creator Saeed TV's weight when challenged to criticise the club's owners.

item.title: Anjali Arora's Kanpur Show Cut Short After Row Over 'Kacha Badam' Song, Organisers Threaten Legal Action
item.description: Influencer Anjali Arora reportedly left a Kanpur dandiya event after about 15 minutes when the DJ played her viral 'Kacha Badam' track, and the event's organiser has accused her of staging a publicity stunt and threatened legal action.

item.title: Bigg Boss 20: Nakul Dhull's Eviction Confirmed On Screen After Fight With Gullu
item.description: Bigg Boss has shown on air that wildcard contestant Nakul Dhull was evicted for his physical fight with Gullu, resolving days of rumour, though whether he gets a re-entry remains unconfirmed.

item.title: Rise and Fall 2: Shehzad Poonawalla's Ultimate Ruler Reign Ends as Sara Gurpal Clashes With Gautam Gulati
item.description: Shehzad Poonawalla's run as Ultimate Ruler on Rise and Fall 2 came to an end this week, and the same stretch of episodes saw Sara Gurpal and Gautam Gulati clash over a dining-table outburst that Gurpal said stirred memories of an abusive relationship.
